name: Herod
summary: The ruler of Galilee who put John the Baptist in prison and later had him beheaded. When Jesus was sent to him during His trial, he mocked Jesus and sent Him back to Pilate.

key_moments.title: Puts John in Prison
key_moments.description: John told Herod it was not lawful for him to have Herodias, his brother Philip's wife, so Herod had him bound in prison. Yet Herod feared John, knowing he was a just and holy man, and heard him gladly.

key_moments.title: Has John Beheaded
key_moments.description: At Herod's birthday supper, the daughter of Herodias danced and pleased him, and he swore to give her whatever she asked. She asked for John's head, and though Herod was very sorry, he had John beheaded.

key_moments.title: Hears of Jesus and Wants to See Him
key_moments.description: Herod heard about all that Jesus was doing and was puzzled, because some said John had risen from the dead. He said he had beheaded John, and he wanted to see Jesus.

key_moments.title: Mocking Jesus
key_moments.description: Pilate sent Jesus to Herod, who was glad and hoped to see a miracle, but Jesus answered him nothing. Herod and his soldiers mocked Jesus, dressed Him in a fine robe and sent Him back, and that day Herod and Pilate became friends.
